description: Update the two steering files (.kiro/steering/arquitetura.md and .kiro/steering/fluxo.md) so they reflect the current code. arquitetura.md must gain: Azure DevOps as a second supported SCM (transport modules under flow/adapters/scm/), .env as the source of secrets (config/secret separation), and per-repo config (auto_dispatch/auto_merge in the squad YAML). fluxo.md must replace every mention of `auto_merge_on_approve` with the new per-repo `auto_merge` naming while staying accurate. Both files are `inclusion: always` steering docs. Independent of FEAT-001 but MUST use identical terminology.
steps: Read .kiro/steering/arquitetura.md and .kiro/steering/fluxo.md fully. Match the existing pt-BR house style (em dashes are used throughout the repo docs; keep them here for consistency).

arquitetura.md — Azure DevOps as second SCM: The current file describes only GitHub and Jira adapters and says 'Adapters são MÓDULOS, não classes'. Add documentation that SCM operations (pull requests, reviews, merge, branch delete) now go through a unified SCM layer in flow/adapters/scm/ with a factory (ScmTransportFactory + ScmRepoConfig in factory.py) selecting between the GitHub transport (flow/adapters/scm/github.py, re-exporting flow/adapters/github_transport.py) and the Azure DevOps transport (flow/adapters/scm/azure_devops.py, REST API + PAT). Note that both transports expose the same surface. Be precise: the issue calls them 'GitHubTransport'/'AzureDevOpsTransport' but the code uses transport modules named github/azure_devops — describe the actual structure (you may note the ADO module mirrors the GitHub transport surface).

arquitetura.md — .env as source of secrets: Add a short subsection under 'Dependências de ambiente' (or a new 'Secrets' subsection) documenting the config/secret separation: non-secret config lives in deployment.config.yaml (see config.example.yaml), while secrets (KIROCREW_WEBHOOK_TOKEN, KIROCREW_WEBHOOK_SECRET, AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT) live in environment variables / .env (gitignored), templated by .env.example and deployment/.env.example (the latter seeded into ~/.kiro/crew/crons/.env by install-cron.sh).

arquitetura.md — per-repo config: Add documentation that squad config now supports per-repo `auto_dispatch` and `auto_merge` flags (flow/config/squad.py: RepoConfig + SquadConfig.auto_dispatch(repo)/auto_merge(repo)). Two declaration sources: inline under `repos:` (map entries with `url` + optional flags, issue #264) and legacy `repos_config:` (issue #245); per-repo overrides the global fallback (workflow_params.auto_merge_on_approve). If the 'Adicionar um novo provedor' section is the natural place to reference flow/adapters/scm/, cross-link it, but do not contradict the existing 'adapters são módulos' explanation for the github/jira issue-provider adapters (those are a different layer from the SCM transport factory — keep both accurate).

fluxo.md — rename auto_merge_on_approve: The file currently mentions `auto_merge_on_approve: true`/`auto_merge_on_approve: false` in the inviolable-rule blockquote at the top and possibly elsewhere. Replace every such mention with the new per-repo `auto_merge` flag naming (e.g., 'faz merge squash se `auto_merge: true` estiver configurado por repo no squad config' and 'Merge é manual por padrão (`auto_merge: false`)'). Keep the meaning identical: merge remains manual by default, auto-merge is per-repo opt-in. After editing, there must be ZERO occurrences of the token `auto_merge_on_approve` in fluxo.md.
After edits, grep both steering files for `auto_merge_on_approve` (expect zero in fluxo.md) and confirm arquitetura.md now references Azure DevOps, .env secrets, and auto_dispatch/auto_merge.
acceptance_criteria: .kiro/steering/arquitetura.md documents Azure DevOps as a second SCM via flow/adapters/scm/ (factory + github/azure_devops transports exposing the same surface)
.kiro/steering/arquitetura.md documents .env as the secrets source and the config/secret separation, referencing .env.example / deployment/.env.example
.kiro/steering/arquitetura.md documents per-repo `auto_dispatch`/`auto_merge` in the squad YAML

.kiro/steering/fluxo.md contains ZERO occurrences of the token `auto_merge_on_approve` and instead uses the per-repo `auto_merge` naming with unchanged meaning (merge manual by default, auto-merge per-repo opt-in)
Both files keep the existing frontmatter (inclusion: always) intact and remain internally consistent with docs/ARCHITECTURE.md
verification: Run: grep -nE 'Azure|scm|auto_dispatch|auto_merge|.env' .kiro/steering/arquitetura.md → expect the new content present
Run: grep -n 'auto_merge' .kiro/steering/fluxo.md → expect the new per-repo naming present
Run the baseline test suite to confirm no code was touched: python3 -m pytest flow/tests/ --cov=flow --cov-fail-under=75
findings:
Updated both steering files (commit 685c4df). fluxo.md: replaced the two `auto_merge_on_approve` mentions in the top inviolable-rule blockquote with per-repo `auto_merge` naming (meaning unchanged: merge manual by default, auto-merge per-repo opt-in); grep confirms ZERO remaining occurrences of the token. arquitetura.md: added (1) a new 'SCM: GitHub e Azure DevOps (flow/adapters/scm/)' section documenting ScmTransportFactory + ScmRepoConfig, the github.py (re-export of github_transport.py, gh CLI) and azure_devops.py (REST+PAT) transports exposing the same surface, plus scm/auto-detection, with a lead-in note distinguishing the SCM transport layer from the github/jira issue-provider modules (kept the existing 'adapters são módulos' section accurate); (2) a 'Secrets — separação config/secret (.env)' subsection under 'Dependências de ambiente' (config in deployment.config.yaml/config.example.yaml, secrets KIROCREW_WEBHOOK_TOKEN/KIROCREW_WEBHOOK_SECRET/AZURE_DEVOPS_PAT in .env, templated by .env.example and deployment/.env.example seeded by install-cron.sh); (3) a 'Config por repo — auto_dispatch / auto_merge' subsection (RepoConfig + SquadConfig.auto_dispatch/auto_merge, inline repos: #264 vs legacy repos_config: #245, inline wins, per-repo overrides global workflow_params.auto_merge_on_approve). Terminology matches the updated README (scm: azure_devops, per-repo auto_merge). Frontmatter (inclusion: always) intact in both. Did NOT touch README.md, docs/ARCHITECTURE.md, or docs/RELEASE.md. VERIFICATION: all three grep checks pass. Test suite (python3.12 -m pytest flow/tests/ --cov=flow --cov-fail-under=75) = 932 passed, 1 skipped, coverage 86.67%; the only 2 failures are the documented PRE-EXISTING unrelated ones (test_dispatch_webhook.py::TestOrphanSlotCleanup::test_delete_orphan_slot_chama_session_control_close and test_prompts_loader.py::TestRenderPromptFallback::test_template_corrompido_ilegivel_usa_fallback), confirming no code was affected by the docs edits. ENV NOTE: host default python3 is 3.9; used /root/.pyenv/shims/python3.12 with pip install -e '.[dev]'.

SEMANTIC-REVIEW ITERATION 1 (2026-09-29-020332-review.md) — finding 3 (residual auto_merge_on_approve in arquitetura.md ~line 276): confirmed the occurrence is FACTUALLY CORRECT — it names the surviving GLOBAL fallback field workflow_params.auto_merge_on_approve (verified in flow/config/squad.py: WorkflowParams.auto_merge_on_approve still exists as the global workflow param; the retired name is the PER-REPO key, replaced by auto_merge). The task acceptance criterion requires zero occurrences only in README.md and fluxo.md (both confirmed empty), NOT arquitetura.md. Kept the field name (accurate) but rephrased the precedence sentence to make explicit that this name survives ONLY as the global workflow parameter, while the homonymous per-repo key was retired in favor of auto_merge — removing any ambiguity for a reader given the 'retire the old name' goal. No functional change; arquitetura.md remains factually aligned with the code.
